note: Bytes per point must come from representative measurements for the selected InfluxDB generation, schema, and workload. The envelope excludes temporary WAL, cache, compaction, index, catalog, backup, and operating-system space unless you include that margin in headroom. A stored-copy count is an architecture assumption, not a universal InfluxDB replication guarantee.
